records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2#3
records.source: Pass 1 — assemble walk originals, parse metadata regex, build one npy stack per field with all image channels in the C axis. Emit ``filename_map.csv`` recording every original → stack mapping.
records.context: Pass 1 — assemble walk originals, parse metadata regex, build one npy stack per microscope field of view with all image data channels in the C axis. Emit ``filename_map.csv`` recording every original → stack mapping.
records.translation: Umferð 1 — safna upprunalegum myndum, túlka lýsigagnareglulega segð og búa til einn npy-stafla á hvert sjónsvið með öllum myndrásum á C-ás. Skrifa ``filename_map.csv`` sem skráir sérhverja vörpun upprunalegrar skráar → stafla.

records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2#4
records.source: Pass 2 — segment stream the plate in batches of N fields, hand each batch to Cellpose, append the mask channels to the SAME stack file. Each batch is written to a scratch NPZ on the way through and deleted again unless ``keep_npz=True``.
records.context: Pass 2 — segment stream the laboratory microplate in batches of N microscope fields of view, hand each batch to Cellpose, append the mask image data channels to the SAME stack file. Each batch is written to a scratch NPZ on the way through and deleted again unless ``keep_npz=True``.
records.translation: Umferð 2 — hluta plötuna í straumi í lotum með N sjónsviðum, senda hverja lotu til Cellpose og bæta grímurásunum við SÖMU staflaskrá. Hver lota er skrifuð tímabundið í NPZ-vinnuskrá og henni eytt aftur nema ``keep_npz=True``.
